code:
-- functions.hs
double :: Int -> Int
double x = x * 2

add :: Int -> Int -> Int
add x y = x + y

-- Partial application: fix the first argument
add5 :: Int -> Int
add5 = add 5       -- add5 is add with first arg fixed to 5

-- Anonymous function (lambda)
square :: Int -> Int
square = \x -> x * x
description: You define functions with type signatures and equations. Partial application fixes an argument and leaves a function for the remaining argument.

steps.description: double takes one Int. add takes an Int and returns a function that takes the next Int.
You define add5 by fixing add's first argument to 5.
A lambda is an anonymous function. This lambda names its input x and returns x multiplied by itself.

title: Define and partially apply functions
